meta.name: what-the
meta.description: What the? Use when the user wants a plain-English breakdown of something technical — the who, what, where, why, and when.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用大白话解释任何技术概念
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常需要向非技术人员解释技术概念
copy.tagline_en: Explain any technical concept in plain English
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain technical concepts to non-technical people

howto.what: 当用户提到某个技术概念或说法时,Claude 会用浅显的英语把它重新解释一遍,并按五个以W开头的疑问词逐个讲清楚。
howto.when: 当用户想得到某个技术话题的通俗英语解释时触发;用户表示某个说法“太技术了”时也可能触发。

say.text: 这技术名词真费解,用简单英语按五W给我讲讲。
say.note: Claude 会给出浅显的多段解释。

say.text: 外行听不懂,用大白话英语说说 DNS 这东西。
say.note: 解释会覆盖它的几个基本疑问点。

say.text: 这个概念太硬核,帮我拆成五W用平实英语说。
say.note: 会得到容易理解的英文转述。

howto.what_en: When the user names something technical, Claude re-explains it in plain English, going through the five W's one by one.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks for a plain-English breakdown of a technical topic, e.g. saying something 'sounds mad technical'.

say_en.text: This term is confusing. Explain it in plain English following the five W's.
say_en.note: Claude gives a simple multi-part explanation.

say_en.text: I'm a layperson. Explain DNS in plain English, please.
say_en.note: The answer covers the key W questions.

say_en.text: This concept is too hard. Break it into the five W's in plain English.
say_en.note: You get an easy-to-follow English explanation.
